title: The Awakening — Principal's Vision Sessions
summary: Our transformation began with conviction from the top. The Principal conducted multiple intensive awareness sessions with all department heads and faculty members, laying the groundwork for a campus-wide AI revolution.
points: Principal-led awareness sessions with all HoDs and faculty across all departments
Introduction to AI terminologies: Machine Learning, Deep Learning, Generative AI, Agentic AI, Quantum Computing
Why AI matters for engineering colleges — impact on admissions, placements, and NAAC
Demystifying Quantum Computing — what it means for our students' future
Building a shared vocabulary and urgency across the institution
Identifying AI champions in each department

title: Building AI — From Theory to Working Portals
summary: March saw HKBK move from awareness to action. Our AIML department built real, working AI applications — proving that AI is not just for tech giants. This hands-on approach earned us national recognition.
points: AI-powered presentation tools deployed for faculty use
UHV (Universal Human Values) Portal — first AI-integrated academic portal
Result Analysis System — automated student performance analysis using AI
Student IA Marks Chatbot — students can query their marks using natural language
Faculty Prompt Library — curated academic prompts for teaching, NAAC, research
HKBK EduStream — YouTube-style college video library with role-based access
badge: AICTE Recognition: Potential Nodal Center for Universal Human Values

title: 6-Month AI Transformation Program — Expert Partnership
summary: HKBK partnered with industry expert **Mr. Rocky Jagtiani** to launch a comprehensive 6-month AI transformation program. Three intensive Faculty Development Programs were conducted, covering prompt engineering, hands-on AI tools, and pedagogical innovation.
points: **FDP Cohort 1** — Prompt Engineering Fundamentals: Persona–Context–Task–Output framework
**FDP Cohort 2** — AI for Academic Work: Lesson plans, question papers, SSR writing, viva questions
**FDP Cohort 3** — Hands-on AI Tools: Hugging Face, Google Colab, Python, APIs
25–30 faculty teams formed; 25–30 real-world problems identified
25–30 prompts built and tested on real documents → Prompt Library v1 created
Design Thinking workshop for faculty innovation

title: Layer 1 Deployed — Awareness Campus Goes Live
summary: May marks the full activation of Layer 1 of the 5-layer AI framework. AI is now being used across departments in teaching, planning, and administration. The transformation is happening at scale.
points: AI-assisted lesson planning deployed across Computer Science, IS, AIML, ECE, MBA
Automated assessments — AI-generated question papers and viva questions
AI literacy program for all students (2nd, 3rd, 4th year)
Multidisciplinary AI projects introduced for 2nd semester students (3 credits)
AI rubrics integrated into Civil, Mechanical, and Humanities assessments
Administrative workflow automation — SSR writing, evidence documentation

title: Universal Human Values 2 (UHV-2) — Values-Led AI Adoption
summary: As AI use grew across the campus, June and July focused on making sure it grows with the right values. Through Universal Human Values 2 (UHV-2), HKBK connected the course's ideas of harmony in the self, family, society and nature with responsible, ethical and human-centred use of AI in teaching, learning and administration.
points: UHV-2 sessions for students linking human values with responsible AI use: honesty, fairness, privacy and respect
Faculty orientation on teaching UHV-2 and guiding students on ethical AI use in coursework
Responsible AI guidelines introduced for assignments, projects and assessments, covering academic integrity and proper disclosure of AI use
Discussions and case studies on AI bias, misinformation, data privacy and the human impact of technology
Student reflection activities on balancing technology with wellbeing, relationships and society
Value-based AI project ideas encouraged, focusing on problems that benefit the community and environment

title: AI in Action — Industry Consultancy: AI Customer-Support Chatbot
summary: The AI First initiative moved from the classroom to real-world delivery with an industry consultancy project: an AI-powered customer-support chatbot and Instagram operations system for Camellia Artisanal, a food business. The system answers customer questions using approved business knowledge and hands over to a human whenever a question needs one.
points: AI chatbot built on structured intent understanding with a controlled RAG/LLM layer, designed never to invent prices, stock, shelf life or delivery promises
Canonical business-knowledge catalogue so every answer comes from one approved source
Instagram integration: replies that recognise which post, reel or Story the customer is responding to, with Story auto-sync
Safe human handoff with owner notifications (admin panel, email and web push)
Privacy safeguards: hashed customer identifiers in logs, with no raw IDs or customer messages stored
Over 2,400 automated tests passing, with staged releases and live acceptance testing before every production update

title: Smart Campus Operations — Digital Systems on the Zoho Platform
summary: September and October took the AI First journey into campus operations. Using the Zoho Creator low-code platform, HKBK began building its own digital systems for the Alumni Portal, Hostel Management and Attendance Management, replacing manual registers and spreadsheets with secure, role-based apps and live dashboards. The systems are being built in-house by HKBK students under faculty mentorship.
points: Hostel Management System for the Boys and Girls hostels: one central app with role-based access for the Principal, Super Admin, Wardens, Operations and Students
Live hostel dashboards with student search, fee tracking, attendance calendar, memos and quick actions
Automated account approvals, maintenance and service tickets raised by students and handled by the Operations team, with urgent-ticket flagging by the Principal
Branded printable reports with one-click PDF and CSV download, carrying the HKBK logo, college name and timestamps
Attendance Management system to record and track attendance digitally, with summaries for faculty and administrators
Alumni Portal to build the HKBK alumni network: alumni registration, profiles and a channel to stay connected with the college
Secure by design: each user sees only the data their role allows
